Delaware running back Greg Spiller is out for the season.

cfb:26OCT13DELMTU.summary: Two 2-3 teams in a near coin-flip game. Delaware's starting quarterback Nick Minicucci is week-to-week with a knee injury and his status is still unknown; backup E.J. Archield started the last game. Weather is warm and dry at an open-air stadium.

cfb:26OCT13FIUJVST.lean: Jacksonville State to win by 4 or more is a reasonable small bet; FIU's offense struggles to keep up.
news: FIU's JJ Kohl has 7 interceptions, most in the league, and FIU averages under 19 points a game (CBS Sports).
Jacksonville State's Creel has over 1,400 passing yards plus 400 rushing yards.
Jacksonville State linebacker Walker O'Steen is out for the season.
cfb:26OCT13FIUJVST.summary: Jacksonville State is a short favorite at home behind dual-threat quarterback Caden Creel, while FIU's offense has struggled and its quarterback has thrown seven interceptions in five games. Most previews back Jacksonville State to win and cover, and the weather is clear.

cfb:26OCT14KENNMOSU.lean: Slight lean Kennesaw State to win by a field goal or more, but not enough to bet.
news: Kennesaw State lost 27-26 to Jacksonville State; Missouri State lost 34-13 at Western Kentucky.
Missouri State ranks 126th against the run and 129th in third-down defense (Springfield Daily Citizen).
Some books have moved Kennesaw State to a 3.5-point favorite.
cfb:26OCT14KENNMOSU.summary: Two 1-4 teams hunting a first league win. Kennesaw State's run game faces a Missouri State defense that ranks near the bottom nationally against the run and on third downs, and there's about a one-in-three chance of rain at an outdoor stadium.

cfb:26OCT14WKUSHSU.lean: No strong lean; the conflicting lines and our ratings favoring Sam Houston cancel out.
news: Lines vary by book from Western Kentucky -2 to Sam Houston -1.5 (FanDuel, Picks and Parlays).
Sam Houston is 1-4 after a 35-3 loss to Liberty.
Western Kentucky won last year's meeting 41-24.
cfb:26OCT14WKUSHSU.summary: A game where the books don't agree: some have Western Kentucky favored, others Sam Houston. Western Kentucky just beat Missouri State 34-13, while Sam Houston lost 35-3 to Liberty, and Western Kentucky has won three of the last four meetings.

mlb:26OCT132000CLETB.lean: Slight lean Cleveland on the pitching matchup, but the price is fair and no player bets during the playoffs.
news: Starters confirmed: Messick (CLE) vs Peralta (TB) (Yahoo Sports, MLB.com).
Messick allowed very few runs this season but had control trouble in his last playoff start.
Expert picks are split on the winner; most lean toward a low-scoring game.
mlb:26OCT132000CLETB.summary: Cleveland leads the series one game to none after a late comeback that snapped Tampa Bay's 13-game winning streak. Tonight it's Cleveland's young lefty Parker Messick, who has been excellent all year but walked four and lasted only two innings in his last start, against Freddy Peralta, who had a rough year for the Rays.

mlb:26OCT142000MILLAD.lean: Lean Dodgers to win at home with Snell, but the listed prices don't give much room. No bet, and no player bets in the playoffs.
news: Snell starts Game 3 and Glasnow Game 4 for the Dodgers (True Blue LA, Yahoo Sports).
Gasser allowed seven runs over about ten innings in two regular-season starts against the Dodgers.
Brewers won Game 2 7-4 behind William Contreras.
mlb:26OCT142000MILLAD.summary: Milwaukee leads the series two games to none after beating Yamamoto in Game 2. The Dodgers go home and turn to Blake Snell, who was almost untouchable after returning from elbow surgery but lasted under four innings in his first playoff start. Milwaukee's Robert Gasser gave up a lot of runs in his two starts against the Dodgers this year.

news: Cavs starters: Harden, Mitchell, Watson, Mobley, Allen; coach Atkinson wants starters playing into the fourth (SI).
Magic listed Bane (rest), Suggs (illness), Black (ankle) and Isaac out on Sunday; Tuesday status not confirmed.
Cavs' Tomlin and Diop remain out.
nba:26OCT13CLEORL.summary: The Cavs beat Orlando on Sunday and head to Orlando with their regular starters expected to play big minutes. The Magic were without Bane, Suggs, Black and Isaac in that game and it's unclear who returns Tuesday.

news: Warriors: Butler and Moody out; Porzingis and Horford game-time decisions (Yahoo Sports).
Lakers: Kessler back at full practice but not guaranteed to play; Dončić could sit after playing Monday.
Dončić, Reaves and Kessler are the Lakers' expected regular starters whenever healthy.
nba:26OCT13GSWLAL.summary: This one is in Las Vegas. The Warriors are without Butler and Moody with Porzingis and Horford question marks, and the Lakers may rest Dončić after he played Monday, with Reaves and Kessler also uncertain. Too many unknowns.

nba:26OCT13INDOKC.lean: Thunder not to win by 11 or more looks good on a back-to-back with their stars likely resting.
news: Holmgren (quad) has not played this preseason and missed Monday's game (CBS Sports).
SGA, Jalen Williams and Hartenstein are all game-time decisions, mostly listed as rest (EssentiallySports).
Haliburton practiced fully Monday; Carlisle said availability is a game-day call.
nba:26OCT13INDOKC.summary: The Thunder played Monday in Atlanta and are on a back-to-back, with Gilgeous-Alexander and Jalen Williams listed as rest decisions and Chet Holmgren still out with a bruised thigh. Haliburton practiced fully Monday and may return for Indiana, which would make a ten-point Thunder win much harder.

nba:26OCT13NYKTOR.lean: I'd lean Raptors to win comfortably, but that side isn't offered, so no bet.
news: Brunson and Towns sit for rest, and a preview says Bridges, Hart and Anunoby are also expected to rest (ESPN, New York Post).
Kawhi Leonard practiced fully Monday and is available for his Toronto debut (coach Rajakovic).
Raptors' Jackson-Davis and Graves are question marks.
nba:26OCT13NYKTOR.summary: The Knicks are resting Brunson, Towns, Bridges, Hart and Anunoby on the second night of a back-to-back, while Kawhi Leonard is cleared to make his Raptors debut in a limited role. That sets up well for Toronto, but the only bets listed here are on the Raptors NOT winning big.

Sabonis was a full practice participant Monday but is questionable for Tuesday (ESPN).

Lille's Ethan Mbappé is suspended for three European games and carrying an ankle injury.
Arsenal are priced at -400 or shorter everywhere, so the books see this as a very likely win.

United are without Dorgu, Sesko, Mazraoui and De Ligt; Shaw and Mainoo missed Monday's training (GiveMeSport).
Hard Rock reports about 80% of the money on Atlético.
ucl:26OCT13ATMMUN.summary: Atlético are fully fit and at home, while Manchester United are missing Sesko, Dorgu, Mazraoui and De Ligt, with Shaw and Mainoo not training on Monday. The books make Atlético the clear favorite and the public money is heavily on them too.

ucl:26OCT13GALBAR.summary: Barcelona have won all nine games this season but travel to a loud Istanbul crowd without Raphinha, and Frenkie de Jong is doubtful. ucl:26OCT13INTBRU.lean: Inter to win, and a cheap price on them winning by only one goal.

ucl:26OCT13INTBRU.summary: Inter host a Club Brugge side missing its best defender, Joel Ordóñez, with winger Carlos Forbs also doubtful. Inter lost their opener to Real Madrid and are missing Stones and Curtis Jones, but at home against this Brugge team they should win.
